subject: Three different friendly prehistoric marine reptiles grouped together in a sunlit ocean habitat, all smiling triumphantly.

foreground.marine_reptile_1: Elasmosaurus: Three-quarter view, gentle happy smile, a comically long elegant neck looping playfully, smooth aquatic blue skin, positioned prominently.
foreground.marine_reptile_2: Mosasaurus: Three-quarter view, cheerful wide smile with dull, friendly cartoon teeth, leathery counter-shaded skin, positioned beside Elasmosaurus.
foreground.marine_reptile_3: Liopleurodon: Three-quarter view, brave happy smile, stylized stubby flippers doing a 'ta-da!' gesture, in the background looking contented.

composition.background: Open, sunlit prehistoric lagoon with shimmering surface ripples overhead, schools of tiny colorful fish, and a clean sandy seafloor. Celebratory, weightless atmosphere.
composition.grouping: Marine reptiles are swimming and floating poised in a way that conveys happiness and success, looking out at the player.

caption_1.style: Bright red, thick 3D mixed-case block letters, positioned top-center.

caption_2.style: Shiny gold, bold 3D mixed-case block letters, positioned clearly below 'Marine Smile!', with glowing sun-flare bubble effects. Text is slightly textured, like polished gold.

visual_logic.overall_mood: Celebratory, rewarding, aquatic accomplishment. Emphasizes a beautiful, sunny marine world.
visual_logic.color_palette: Deep sea teals, vibrant coral oranges, bright yellow sunbeams, with the red and gold captions offering supreme contrast.
